entries.text: Fixed PostgreSQL Read Primitives queries that PostgreSQL has no function for (ARG_MAX/ARG_MIN, GROUP BY ALL, array, struct, lambda, JSON, ASOF and UNPIVOT queries), which now run as PostgreSQL variants, while approximate-aggregate and map queries PostgreSQL cannot express natively are skipped; fixed the repeatable-read and serializable Transaction Primitives operations; and Vector Search now runs on the pgvector image, creates the extension and selects the pgvector queries.
